name: get_loan_details
description: Fetch the current outstanding amount, due date and days overdue for a loan. Call this at the start of the call if any loan variable is missing. Never state an amount that did not come from this tool.

name: record_payment_promise
description: Record a promise to pay. Only call after the customer has stated a date, and only after you have read the promise back and they confirmed it.

promise_date.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD. Null if the customer would not commit to a specific date.

promise_amount.description: Amount in rupees the customer committed to. Null if not stated. Never estimate.

partial.description: True if less than the full overdue amount

notes.description: Customer's own words, verbatim, if the promise was vague

name: mark_dispute
description: Flag that the customer contests something. Ends the collections attempt — do not keep pressing after calling this.

name: mark_do_not_call
description: Customer asked not to be contacted. Call immediately on request, before any persuasion attempt. Legally required.

name: mark_wrong_number
description: The person reached is not the borrower and does not know them.

name: schedule_callback
description: Customer cannot talk now. Only offer slots between 08:00 and 19:00 IST — RBI restricts recovery calls outside those hours.

callback_at.description: ISO datetime, IST, must be between 08:00 and 19:00

name: transfer_to_human
description: Hand off to a human agent. Use for settlement or restructuring requests, disputes the customer wants resolved live, language mismatch, or any direct request for a human.

context.description: One-line summary so the human does not restart the conversation
